description: Java class 'IdempotencyStoreHelper' providing helper methods for handling idempotency in request processing within the Fineract project, including storing command results and checking content types.

classes.name: IdempotencyStoreHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing idempotency-related operations such as storing command results and checking request/response content types.

methods.name: storeCommandResult
methods.description: Stores the result of a command, including response code and body, associated with a command ID.

methods.name: isAllowedContentTypeResponse
methods.description: Checks if the response content type is allowed (application/json) or if the response status indicates success.

methods.name: isAllowedContentTypeRequest
methods.description: Checks if the request content type is application/json.

methods.name: isStoreIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Determines if the idempotency key should be stored based on request attributes.

methods.name: getCommandId
methods.description: Retrieves the command ID from the request context if available.
